info.title: Sumurai Financial API
info.description: Multi-tenant financial aggregation platform with unified Plaid and Teller integration

get.description: Aggregates balances by institution and overall totals, with optional account filtering.
Returns category-level spend for the supplied filters.
Provides daily spending totals for a given month (defaults to current month).

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: Month in YYYY-MM format (defaults to current month)

get.description: Produces a timeline of monthly totals for dashboard charts.
Generates a historical net worth series between the supplied start and end dates.

400.description: Invalid date format or end_date before start_date

get.description: Aggregates spending across a user-defined date range.
Calculates the user's total spending for the current calendar month.
Surfaces the top merchants by spend within the filter window.

delete.description: Deletes the authenticated user's account and associated provider data.

post.description: Sign in with email and password when the account has no enrolled passkey. Returns the same auth_token cookie as passkey login. Rejected when a passkey exists or the password does not match.
Invalidates the active JWT and clears cached session state.

put.description: Marks onboarding complete and refreshes user metadata.

get.description: List all enrolled passkeys for the authenticated user.

post.description: Begin passkey enrollment for the authenticated user (settings or migration). Requires an auth_token cookie; complete with enroll/finish.
Complete authenticated passkey enrollment and return the enrolled passkey.
Begin passkey authentication. Returns a challenge for any email; response shape is identical for unknown emails to prevent user enumeration.
Complete passkey authentication and receive an auth_token cookie.

400.description: Challenge not found, expired, or invalid response

post.description: Complete passkey signup or recovery enrollment without an auth cookie. Returns an auth_token cookie on success. Authenticated enrollment uses enroll/finish instead.

delete.description: Remove an enrolled passkey. Returns 409 if it is the last credential.

post.description: Creates a new user and begins passkey enrollment. No auth cookie is issued until passkey registration completes.

403.description: IP temporarily banned after repeated abuse

get.description: Retrieves all budgets for the authenticated user, leveraging Redis caching when available.

post.description: Creates a new budget entry for the user with category and amount.

put.description: Updates the amount of an existing budget owned by the authenticated user.

delete.description: Deletes a budget and invalidates cached budget data.

200.description: List of system and custom categories

get.description: Downloads the current user's stored accounts and transactions as CSV or OFX.
Lists linked accounts with transaction counts for the user.

200.description: List of user accounts with transaction counts

post.description: Clears cached transactions for the calling user's session.
Exchanges a Plaid public token for a persisted access token.
Generates a provider-specific link token for Plaid/Teller flows.
Completes provider connect enrollment and stores provider credentials for the user.
Disconnects a provider connection and clears related cached artifacts.

get.description: Describes available providers and the caller's current selection.

200.description: Available providers and current user provider configuration

post.description: Persists a provider switch for the authenticated user.

409.description: Cannot switch while active connections exist

get.description: Lists SimpleFIN bridge institutions the user has hidden in Sumurai.

post.description: Removes a SimpleFIN institution from the ignore list so connect/sync can import it again. Idempotent: returns 200 even if the institution was not on the ignore list.

200.description: Institution restored (or was already not ignored)

get.description: Summarizes connection status, sync metrics, and active institutions for the selected provider.

post.description: Kicks off a provider sync to pull the latest transactions.

404.description: Connection not found or credentials missing

get.description: Returns transactions with optional server-side pagination and filtering.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search transactions by merchant, category, or account
